name: Guajará-Mirim (Brazil)
description: White field with a diagonal band of dark blue, yellow and red rising from the lower hoist to the upper fly and a dark blue star in the upper hoist.
history: Guajará-Mirim is a municipality in the state of Rondônia, Brazil, on the Bolivian border. Flags of the World records that the star stands for the newest state of the federation, white for peace, blue for the rivers, yellow for mineral wealth and red for neighbouring Bolivia; the diagonal lines recall the Madeira-Mamoré railway and highway BR-425.

features.role: diagonal band of dark blue, yellow and red
